records.rationale: Both complete patch paths reviewed. Retain ten proxy scheduler trace events and their current wake/selection/migration call sites for Android diagnostics; exact SDK consumer is unconfirmed, so absence is not used to omit the interface. Original proxy_force_return site was removed by later helper rewrite. Whole final event header equals ACK except sixteen strscpy-to-strscpy_pad substitutions: initialize comm-array tails in raw records without changing event fields/printed strings. Read-side task lifetime traced through rq/blocked-lock ownership, caller pi_lock, activation references and preempt/IRQ-disabled RCU protection. No scheduler algorithm or LTS fix is changed by this adaptation. Tracing can expose task activity and incurs enabled-probe overhead; native trace permissions remain, no runtime/concurrency validation claimed.

header_relationship: Entire header equals final ACK after reverting only sixteen comm-copy padding substitutions.

lifetime.activation: Only callers are try_to_wake_up (whole-function guard(preempt)) and sched_ttwu_pending (rq_unlock retains IRQ-disabled state until final rq_unlock_irqrestore). Owner is explicitly referenced while on bal_head. blocked_node is removed under owner blocked_lock; p may wake/exit after detachment, but native task rcu_users reference is released by call_rcu(delayed_put_task_struct), which waits for these preempt/IRQ-disabled regions. Thus p allocation remains live through trace and get_task_struct(p) for next bal_head entry. No new get/put or lock needed for observational trace.
lifetime.owner_migration: find_proxy_task takes actual blocked lock wait_lock and rechecks p blocked_on under p blocked_lock before reading owner; guard remains across owner/migration trace calls. Sleeping-owner enqueue also holds owner blocked_lock and rq lock. Task cannot finish its lock unlock path and be freed while wait_lock held.
lifetime.selection: __schedule holds rq lock when tracing prev/donor/next. Migration/deactivation resets rq donor before dropping rq lock; retries reload donor. Events run before context switch. Original force-return trace site is absent in final helper and is not reintroduced.
lifetime.return: ttwu_runnable called with waking task pi_lock, additionally acquires rq lock; trace occurs after proxy_needs_return while those guards remain.

padding: strscpy guarantees termination but not zero-filled remainder. Native trace reservation initializes trace_entry metadata, not the complete event payload; generic event expansion runs only TP_fast_assign. Sixteen strscpy_pad calls use native sized_strscpy_pad to zero bytes after terminator. Scope is comm arrays, not a claim all C-structure padding or arbitrary trace probes are sanitized. Native access controls remain; no unprivileged leak exploit demonstrated.
uncertainty: Exact proxy debug event consumer unconfirmed. Retained generic Android diagnostics conservatively. Comm/prio/CPU values can race with legitimate updates; lifetime safety does not imply an atomic diagnostic snapshot. No runtime tracing, scheduler performance, or arbitrary callback behavior was tested.
validation: Full header identity after bounded substitution and native task release-function identity checked.
